_readme: MASTER PRODUCT FILE — edit this file only to add/change products. No code changes needed. Fields: id (unique, lowercase, hyphens), name, category ('biostimulant' or 'biofertilizer'), form ('liquid' or 'solid'), icon (emoji until real photos), image (optional path like assets/img/humic-5l.jpg — overrides icon), short (one-line benefit), desc (2-3 sentences), benefits (list), crops (list), dose, packs ({size: price in INR, or null = 'Ask on WhatsApp'}). Liquid sizes: 250ml/500ml/1L/5L. Solid sizes: 500g/1kg/2kg/4kg/8kg/25kg. Set sample:true on placeholder entries; remove when real data is in.

products.name: Humic acid 5% (Powder)
products.short: Soil conditioning in compact, low organic-matter or over-cropped soils
products.desc: A low-concentration humic powder that blends easily into fertiliser mixes, organic manures and soil-applied products.
benefits: Soil conditioning in compact, low organic-matter or over-cropped soils
Holding nutrients near the root zone so less is lost from the profile
Complexing micronutrients and improving their availability
Supporting early root development at sowing or transplanting
Getting more value from the fertiliser already being applied
apply: Basal application mixed with fertiliser (granules and powders)
Drip or fertigation (liquids and soluble powders)
Soil drench around the root zone
Foliar spray (fulvic and fully soluble grades)
products.mixing: Humic grades mix with most fertilisers. Avoid tank-mixing with strongly acidic products or high-calcium solutions without a jar test, because humic acid can precipitate at low pH.
products.dose: Dose as per label and crop dose chart — ask on WhatsApp for your crop.
